title: Analista de Relacionamento com Cliente
description:
Nós somos a EasyJur e estamos mudando o mundo!


A EasyJur é uma Legaltech que tem como missão revolucionar a forma de trabalho do advogado por meio da inteligência humana e artificial. Sabemos que construímos algo que é genuinamente útil para as pessoas: todo advogado ou advogada que adota o #easyjur como sua solução central tem percebido rapidamente os benefícios gerados pela transformação digital.

Acreditamos que pensar e fazer diferente é o caminho para superar as injustiças que vivemos e transformar as dificuldades em combustível para criar não somente um software jurídico e sim construir um mundo mais justo.


Seja um #Easyforce com a gente!

O que a gente espera de você?


Buscamos uma pessoa com forte orientação ao cliente, organização e capacidade de atuar com autonomia na gestão de demandas. Esperamos alguém proativo, analítico e com habilidade para construir relacionamentos de confiança.

É importante ter facilidade para acompanhar indicadores, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e atuar de forma estratégica para garantir a melhor experiência do cliente ao longo da jornada.

Também esperamos uma atuação colaborativa com outras áreas da empresa, contribuindo para retenção, engajamento e crescimento da base de clientes. 


No seu dia a dia, você será responsável por:


  • Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes (escritórios de advocacia de pequeno e médio porte), acompanhando sua jornada de sucesso com foco em adoção, retenção e expansão, garantindo que cada cliente alcance impacto recorrente mensurável com a plataforma;


  • Compreender o contexto operacional dos clientes: rotina de prazos processuais, gestão de equipes jurídicas, fluxos de peticionamento, controle de produtividade de advogados e compliance para traduzir funcionalidades da EasyJur em resultados de negócio concretos;


  • Monitorar indicadores como NPS, churn, health score, NRR e engajamento de produto, propondo ações preventivas e corretivas com base em dados;


  • Utilizar ferramentas de inteligência artificial (LLMs, agentes autônomos e automações) para escalar a gestão da carteira, automatizando análises de health score, gerando insights preditivos de churn, personalizando comunicações e aumentando a capacidade de atendimento sem perder qualidade;


  • Conduzir Impact Reviews e reuniões de alinhamento periódicas, fortalecendo a relação de confiança e demonstrando valor entregue versus objetivos acordados;


  • Mapear riscos de churn e oportunidades de expansão (upsell e cross-sell de módulos), atuando em parceria com o time comercial para gerar CSQLs (CS Qualified Leads);


  • Contribuir para a criação e manutenção de playbooks, cadências de engajamento e processos de CS;


  • Repassar feedbacks estruturados de clientes para Produto, Suporte e Implementação, influenciando melhorias contínuas na plataforma;


  • Apoiar na integração de novos clientes junto ao time de onboarding, garantindo a qualidade do handoff e a definição clara de critérios de sucesso.


O que buscamos de conhecimento técnico?


  • Experiência com ferramentas de CRM e CS (ex: HubSpot, RD Station ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em métricas de receita recorrente: NPS, churn rate, NRR, GRR, health score e LTV;
  • Conhecimento do contexto de negócio de escritórios de advocacia de pequeno e médio porte: entender as dores operacionais do dia a dia jurídico (gestão de prazos, volume processual, produtividade de equipe, compliance, controle financeiro de honorários) para conectar a plataforma ao impacto real no negócio do cliente;
  • Domínio intermediário de planilhas (Excel ou Google Sheets);
  • Familiaridade com ambientes SaaS B2B e cultura de produto.


Será um diferencial:


  • Experiência em startups ou empresas de tecnologia B2B SaaS;
  • Conhecimento e domínio de ferramentas de inteligência artificial: uso prático de LLMs (N8N, Claude, Gemini, NotebookLM, etc.), construção de prompts estruturados, e noções de implementação de agentes autônomos e automações com IA para aumentar eficiência operacional;
  • Conhecimento do framework SPICED (Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical Event, Decision) da Winning by Design — para conduzir diagnósticos de impacto, estruturar conversas consultivas e garantir handoffs de qualidade entre times;
  • Conhecimento do modelo Bowtie da Winning by Design compreendendo a jornada do cliente (do primeiro impacto à expansão), métricas por estágio (Volume, Conversion Rate, Performance) e o papel do CSM no lado direito do funil (Onboard → Adopt → Expand);
  • Experiência com Joint Impact Plans ou planos de sucesso estruturados com metas de 30/60/90 dias;
  • Conhecimento prévio do mercado jurídico ou forte interesse em aprender sobre o setor.
  • Conhecimento e domínio de ferramentas de inteligência artificial como LLMs e implementação de Agentes Autônomos.




O que você pode esperar de nós:


Aqui você vai encontrar um time comprometido em trabalhar em alta performance e a entregar resultados acima da média;

Um ambiente dinâmico além do padrão de empresas tradicionais e hierarquias verticais;

Aqui quebramos o paradigma de ?manda quem pode e obedece quem tem juízo\";

Temos como meta diária empoderar as pessoas e potencializar talentos.


Benefícios:


  • Programa EasyFamily
  • Programa Saúde e bem estar - Plano de saúde, atividade física e apoio psicológico;
  • Apoio internet backup (Remotos)
  • Day off em seu aniversário;

  • Possibilidade de contrato stock options;

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Node.js- Backend)
description:
About Us

HG Insights is the global leader in technology intelligence, delivering actionable AI driven insights through advanced data science and scalable big data solutions. Our platform informs go-to-market decisions, and we influence how businesses spend millions of marketing and sales budgets.

What You’ll Do

We’re searching for an experienced backend JavaScript engineer to join our product teams and help build systems that are simple, intuitive, and scalable. We develop big-data platforms using modern technologies and architectures, giving engineers the autonomy to learn, grow, and ship impactful products.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, and fellow engineers on our Insights Platform, designing and building reliable backend services that power great user experiences. Our backend stack is primarily based on Node.js .

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Work as part of our Product Engineering teams
  • Architect, design, and implement service-oriented backend systems and APIs
  • Build, maintain, and evolve RESTful APIs
  • Collaborate on ideas across the team, from concept through production
  • Fix bugs quickly while continuously improving system reliability and performance
  • Participate in our on-call rotation and help investigate and resolve production issues
  • Attend daily stand-ups and planning sessions, collaborate at a fast pace, and help raise the engineering bar


What You’ll Need

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent real-world experience
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript , with a backend focus
  • Proven experience applying system and code design patterns in production environments
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Codex, Claude, Gemini) with advanced workflows
  • A self-learner and technology advocate comfortable working across different areas of the system
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-growing, high-ownership environment
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience building or maintaining enterprise-grade SaaS applications with large datasets
  • Experience designing or building AI-powered features or systems
  • Experience working with Python
  • Enjoys startup culture where individual contributions are visible, impactful, and valued

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: AI Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil
description:
AI Agent Builder Job Core Responsibilities

  • Agent Construction & Workflow Setup: Use low-code platforms (e.g., Coze, n8n, Dify) to build and debug Chatflows. You will be responsible for setting up the logic branches, slot filling, and task-oriented closed loops.
  • Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Write and refine high-quality System Prompts to control AI behavior, persona, and task accuracy. Continuously optimize prompts based on real-world interaction data.
  • System Integration & Debugging: Support the integration of AI Agents with client systems (CRM, Helpdesk, etc.) via APIs and Webhooks. Use basic coding (Python/JS) to handle data parsing and custom logic nodes.
  • Local Scripting & Voice Strategy: Translate and adapt AI scripts to fit local linguistic nuances. Define voice strategies—including tone, speed, and emphasis, to ensure a natural, human-like voice experience.
  • QA & Daily Operations: Monitor AI performance, identify \"Bad Cases,\" and perform troubleshooting. Conduct pre-launch testing (UAT) to ensure the agent meets quality standards before deployment.
  • Global Collaboration: Communicate with international clients and cross-functional teams (R&D, Sales) to deconstruct requirements and deliver localized solutions.

AI Agent Builder Core Qualifications

  • Language: Fluent in English (Spoken & Written). You can confidently lead technical meetings and write high-quality, professional prompts/documentation.
  • Logical Thinking: Strong ability to deconstruct complex business needs into clear, step-by-step logic flows.
  • Technical Foundation:
  • Basic Python/JS skills (must know how to parse JSON and handle API/Webhook data).
  • Conceptual understanding of LLMs and a strong intuition for Prompt Engineering .
  • Fast Learner: Ability to quickly master new Agent Builder/Workflow tools (e.g., Coze, n8n) and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
About the Company


Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.



About the Role


We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas
  • Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance
  • Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation
  • Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers
  • Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis
  • Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards
  • Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues
  • Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way
  • Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively


Requirements

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis
  • Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment
  • Able to pass a background check


Preferred

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools
  • Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment
  • Experience with AWS-based data environments
  • Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation
  • Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases
  • Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts


How to Apply

Please send your resume in English.

title: AI Project Manager
description:
We are seeking a senior Project Manager to join our team.

The ideal candidate must have a strong background in project management, specifically in the AI domain.


This role involves overseeing ongoing AI projects , managing client relationships , coordinating with internal teams , and ensuring the successful delivery of projects .

We are looking for individuals who are not only skilled in project management but also enthusiastic about AI and eager to drive new solutions.


While technical expertise is valuable, the primary focus is on project management , product ownership and client satisfaction . This role sits in the Digital Transformation Center and will be close to delivery and research teams.


  • Work model: remote from Brazil;
  • Contract type: contractor / “PJ”;
  • Availability to work according to North American’s Eastern Standard Time (EST).


Job Mission :

  • To manage AI projects, ensuring successful delivery.
  • To encourage a culture of excellence within the team.
  • To advance AI initiatives through cross-functional collaboration.
  • To engage across functions (SMEs, technical teams, leaderships) to guarantee delivery quality.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Project Management: Lead end-to-end project management for AI initiatives, from initiation to successful delivery. Develop project plans, allocate resources, track progress, and ensure timely completion of milestones and deliverables;
  • Client Engagement: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring clear communication. Understand client needs, manage expectations, and address concerns promptly to achieve customer satisfaction;
  • Risk Management: Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies. Proactively address issues that may impact project timelines, scope, or quality, ensuring smooth project execution;
  • Reporting and Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including project plans, progress reports, and stakeholder communications. Ensure that project status and updates are communicated effectively to both internal teams and clients;
  • Team Leadership: Provide leadership and direction to project teams, fostering a collaborative and results-driven environment. Mentor team members, promote knowledge sharing, and support professional growth;
  • Global Approach: Interact with other regions, partners and ventures following a global approach to ensure consistency and alignment in AI project management across the organization.


Required Experience :

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Project Management, or a related field;
  • Experience in managing projects AI projects from conception to delivery;
  • Familiarity with AI technologies and their applications;
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools;
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate challenges and adapt to changing project requirements;
  • Critical thinking and problem solving to assess client situation and provide actionable outcome-based business/technical advice;
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or other relevant project management certifications (preferred);
  • Proficiency in English is mandatory;
  • Proficiency in Portuguese is desirable.


Required Technical Knowledge :

  • Familiarity with AI concepts, terminology, and industry trends;
  • Understanding of project management methodologies specific to AI projects;
  • Ability to evaluate technical feasibility and make informed project decisions based on technical considerations;
  • Proficiency in using project management software and tools for AI project tracking and management;
  • Knowledge and experience on conducting projects for IT and Service Desk solutions.
  • A background in IT environments, including an understanding of how various IT components and systems operate, is highly beneficial. This knowledge helps in navigating technical aspects, ensuring seamless integration of AI solutions within existing IT infrastructures;
  • Product ownership and ability to work in an agile environment and create user stories;
  • Excellent communication skills;
  • Strong project management skills.

title: SAP Treasury Technology Professional

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Long Term Contract

  • Extensive hands-on experience with SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) module configuration and support

  • SAP Treasury certification or relevant SAP certifications (SAP Certified Application Associate)
  • Experience with cloud-based treasury solutions and treasury-in-the-cloud implementations
  • Knowledge of SWIFT messaging standards and bank communication protocols
  • Experience with treasury risk management, hedging, and derivatives processing
  • Familiarity with treasury workstation tools (e.g., Kyriba, GTreasury, FIS)
  • Understanding of regulatory compliance requirements related to treasury operations (SOX, internal controls)
  • Experience in a global, multi-entity corporate treasury environment
  • Knowledge of RPA (Robotic Process Automation) applications in treasury operations

Skills and Competencies:

Technical Skills:

  • Expert knowledge of SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) module
  • Proficiency in SAP Financial Accounting (FI) and integration points
  • Advanced understanding of electronic banking, payment formats, and bank connectivity protocols
  • Strong knowledge of treasury operations including cash management, liquidity management, and payment processing
  • Experience with ABAP debugging and user exits (beneficial for troubleshooting)
  • Database and SQL knowledge for reporting and data analysis
  • Understanding of APIs and web services for system integrations


Soft Skills:

  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail
  • Excellent communication skills for both technical and business audiences
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities with internal teams and external banking partners
  • Project management skills with ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global, cross-functional team environment
  • Strategic thinking with ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
  • Change management and training capabilities
  • Adaptability and flexibility in a fast-paced, evolving technology landscape

title: Social Media Lead/Community Manager
description:
We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

• Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

• Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

• Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

• Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

• Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

• Analyze performance and double down on what works


Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

• Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

• Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

• Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

• Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing. 
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
About the Company


Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.



About the Role


We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas
  • Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance
  • Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation
  • Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers
  • Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis
  • Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards
  • Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues
  • Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way

Requirements

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis
  • Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment
  • Able to pass a background check

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable RESTful or GraphQL APIs consumed by Android and iOS clients
  • Build and maintain microservices using Java, Node.js, Python, or Go (per team stack)
  • Define and document API contracts and data schemas in collaboration with mobile developers
  • Manage database design, query optimization, and migrations (SQL and/or NoSQL)
  • Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices (OAuth 2.0, JWT)
  • Develop and maintain backend test suites; collaborate with SDETs on integration testing
  • Maintain JIRA user stories and technical tasks for backend workstream
  • Monitor service health, diagnose production issues, and lead root cause analysis
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for backend services
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies and technical planning sessions

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 7+ years of backend development experience
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language: Java, Node.js (TypeScript), Python, or Go
  • Strong experience designing and building RESTful APIs for mobile clients
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes or ECS)
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Familiarity with JIRA for backlog and sprint management
  • Understanding of security practices: OAuth, JWT, HTTPS, input validation
  • Experience with automated testing and integration with CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong commitment to Test Driven Development (TDD) practices for backend service quality
  • Experience building backends specifically optimized for mobile (bandwidth-efficient, low-latency APIs)
  • Familiarity with push notification infrastructure (FCM, APNs)
  • Knowledge of event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS/SNS)
  • Exposure to GraphQL API design


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.

title: Entitlement Engineer
description:
Position : Entitlement Engineer

Duration : Long Term Contract

Location : Brazil, Chille, Colombia ,Costa Rica-LATM

Pay Range: $22/hr - $24/hr



Day to Day:

Insight Global is seeking an IAM Engineer with strong SAP GRC Access Control expertise to support identity and access governance across Tenneco / DRiV’s SAP environments. This individual will manage and enhance SAP GRC capabilities across multiple landscapes, ensure access controls meet audit and compliance standards, and partner closely with security, compliance, and business stakeholders.


Specific Responsibilities:

  • SAP GRC Administration:
  • Manage, administer, and control SAP GRC Access Control across multiple landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • GRC Configuration & Support:
  • Configure, maintain, and support SAP GRC modules, including ARA, ARM, and EAM
  • Troubleshoot workflow failures and access provisioning issues
  • Workflow & Rules Management:
  • Design, configure, and maintain BRF+ rules and MSMP workflows for access requests and approvals
  • SAP Role Management:
  • Perform SAP role design, build, maintenance, and remediation across SAP systems
  • Support user provisioning, de-provisioning, and role changes in compliance with internal controls
  • SoD & Risk Management:
  • Conduct Segregation of Duties analysis, remediation, and mitigation
  • Collaborate with business and application owners to resolve access risks
  • Audit & Compliance Support:
  • Provide access reports, logs, and audit evidence from SAP GRC
  • Partner with security, audit, and compliance teams during reviews and remediation efforts
  • Continuous Improvement:
  • Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and ongoing IAM/GRC process improvements


Qualifications :

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent professional experience
  • 6–7+ years of experience in IAM Engineering roles
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP GRC Access Control (implementation and production support required)
  • Experience across multiple GRC landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • In-depth experience with the following SAP GRC modules:
  • Access Risk Analysis (ARA)
  • Access Request Management (ARM)
  • Emergency Access Management (EAM / Firefighter)
  • Strong knowledge of BRF+ rules design and MSMP workflow configuration
  • Extensive experience in SAP role design, build, remediation, and maintenance
  • Single and composite roles
  • SAP authorization concepts (SU24, roles, profiles)
  • Experience conducting Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis and remediation
  • Proven experience supporting audits and partnering with compliance teams
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Experience supporting large manufacturing, automotive, or global enterprise environments


Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP Security and/or SAP GRC certifications
  • Experience in large, global enterprise SAP environments
  • Familiarity with additional SAP platforms and modules
  • ECC, S/4HANA, Fiori Security





**Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

**Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Remote

ASAP HIRE



We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to help design, build, and operate reliable cloud infrastructure systems. This role is hands-on and operational in nature, with a strong focus on infrastructure as code, cloud services, and continuous delivery. You’ll work closely with engineering and platform teams to ensure our infrastructure is secure, scalable, and maintainable.

This is a highly collaborative role suited for someone who enjoys balancing delivery with operational excellence in a fast-moving environment.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure using infrastructure‑as‑code practices
  • Support and improve Kubernetes-based platforms, containerized workloads, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Build and operate AWS-based infrastructure using services such as Lambda, API Gateway, AWS Transfer Family, RDS, and S3
  • Partner with engineering teams to improve reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency
  • Support identity and access workflows, including SAML-based integrations
  • Contribute to technical documentation, design decisions, and operational runbooks
  • Prioritize and manage work in a Kanban-style operational environment with competing demands


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and networking fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD systems in real-world environments
  • Practical experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, including modules, state management, and multi-environment deployments
  • Solid understanding of operational concerns such as system reliability, scalability, security, and cost
  • Experience building and supporting AWS infrastructure
  • Experience using GitHub Actions to support CI/CD workflows
  • Strong understanding of identity concepts, including authentication, authorization, and SAML
  • Strong written communication skills, especially for technical documentation and design explanations
  • Ability to prioritize work effectively and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously


Nice to Have

  • Experience with tools such as Netlify, Okta, Apache Kafka, or Redis
  • Background working on platform or developer enablement teams
  • Experience supporting infrastructure in regulated or compliance-focused environments

title: Paid Ads Specialist — Meta & Google Ads
description:
Hyre is a fast-growing virtual assistant service company dedicated to providing exceptional support to our clients. We value innovation, efficiency, and a commitment to excellence. Join us and be part of a dynamic team that empowers businesses to thrive.


We are looking for a skilled Meta & Google Ads Specialist to join a fast-growing digital marketing team supporting multiple U.S.-based brands. This role is ideal for someone who loves performance marketing, enjoys optimizing campaigns, and thrives in a data-driven environment.

If you have proven experience managing paid ads, strong analytical skills, and the creativity to develop compelling ad copy, we want to meet you.


About the Client

Our client is a U.S.-based digital marketing organization that helps businesses scale through data-driven advertising strategies. They manage a diverse portfolio of brands and rely heavily on performance marketing, strategic optimization, and high-quality creative execution to drive consistent results.


About the Role

As a Meta & Google Ads Specialist, you will be responsible for planning, launching, optimizing, and scaling paid advertising campaigns. You’ll collaborate closely with internal teams to execute strategies, improve performance, and maintain consistent results across multiple ad accounts.

This is a high-impact role for someone who can work independently, thinks strategically, and brings strong technical expertise.


⭐ What You’ll Do

  • Plan, execute, and optimize Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns across various funnel stages.
  • Conduct audience and competitor research to build strong targeting foundations.
  • Write effective ad copy and collaborate on creative direction.
  • Analyze daily performance metrics and implement optimizations to achieve KPIs (CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPM, etc.).
  • Prepare performance reports and communicate insights clearly.
  • Develop and test new strategies, audiences, creatives, and bid structures.
  • Collaborate with internal teams for strategy reviews and campaign planning.
  • Maintain structured documentation and follow internal paid media processes.


Ideal Candidate

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience running Meta Ads and Google Ads.
  • Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics and optimization tactics.
  • Skilled in writing compelling ad copy for testing and scaling.
  • Analytical thinker with the ability to interpret data and make actionable recommendations.
  • Proactive communicator who can work independently in a remote setting.
  • Comfortable working during U.S.-aligned hours and managing deadlines.


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience with reporting dashboards (GA, Looker Studio, etc.)
  • Experience with e-commerce or lead generation funnels
  • Familiarity with A/B testing frameworks and retargeting strategy
  • Basic Canva or creative briefing experience


Schedule

  • Full-time
  • Remote
  • U.S.-aligned working hours


Compensation

  • Competitive salary based on experience and demonstrated skill level.


How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Your updated resume
  • Portfolio or screenshots of past ads you’ve managed
  • Sample ad copy (if available)

Garantir que novos seguidores qualificados sejam ativados rapidamente, que as reuniões sejam agendadas com qualidade e que a presença (show rate) nas calls aconteça todos os dias — abordagem + conexão + confirmação + comunicação impecável.

title: Arquiteto de Soluções em Nuvem e IA
description:
Sobre  a Oportunidade  


Estamos buscando um Arquiteto de Soluções em Nuvem para se juntar ao time de transformação do Ad Intelligence, com foco no design e implementação de soluções orientadas por IA para segmentação e classificação de publicidade em TV. Este papel combina responsabilidade arquitetural com execução técnica hands-on, incluindo provisionamento de infraestrutura, configuração de DevOps/MLOps e colaboração próxima com times de engenharia e ciência de dados. Você será responsável pelo design de sistemas de ponta a ponta para ingestão de vídeo, processamento, armazenamento, implantação de modelos e serviços de inteligência de conteúdo, garantindo confiabilidade, segurança, performance e alinhamento com a estratégia de produto.  


Principais Responsabilidades  


Design de Arquitetura de Ponta a Ponta: Definir e ser responsável pela arquitetura em nuvem (Azure, GCP ou similar) para ingestão de vídeo em larga escala, processamento, pipelines de IA e plataformas de inteligência de conteúdo. 


Engenharia de Infraestrutura em Nuvem: Construir e configurar infraestrutura escalável (compute, storage, networking, serviços serverless, containers) utilizando ferramentas de IaC para suportar workloads de vídeo e ML. 


Gestão de DevOps & Pipelines CI/CD: Implementar e manter CI/CD, testes automatizados, observabilidade e pipelines de deploy para dados, ML e serviços backend. 


MLOps & Implantação de Modelos: Colaborar com cientistas de dados para operacionalizar modelos de IA/ML, garantindo eficiência no treinamento, inferência, monitoramento e gestão de ciclo de vida. 


Integração: Definir padrões de integração para pipelines de dados, APIs e serviços nativos de nuvem para permitir escalabilidade global. 


Liderança Técnica: Orientar times de engenharia e ciência de dados sobre melhores práticas e padrões arquiteturais. 


Conformidade & Segurança: Garantir aderência aos princípios de IA Responsável, GDPR e políticas internas de proteção de dados. 


Otimização de Performance & Custos: Avaliar continuamente e otimizar performance do sistema, escalabilidade, confiabilidade e eficiência de custos em nuvem em todos os componentes. 


Engajamento com Stakeholders: Traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos e comunicar decisões arquiteturais de forma clara. 


Requisitos  


O candidato ideal combina profunda expertise técnica em arquitetura de soluções em nuvem (incluindo GenAI) com fortes habilidades de liderança e comunicação. Destaca-se na criação de sistemas escaláveis e seguros e atua bem em ambientes colaborativos e dinâmicos. 


Experiência Profissional:  


  • Mínimo de 5 a 7 anos de experiência em funções de arquitetura de soluções em nuvem, preferencialmente em ambientes de mídia, tecnologia ou orientados por IA.  
  • Experiência prática significativa na implantação de sistemas em produção em Azure ou GCP com foco em escalabilidade e confiabilidade.  
  • Experiência com integração, transformação, armazenamento e análise de dados, incluindo workflows de vídeo (ingestão, processamento, transformação e análise).  
  • Experiência comprovada na implementação de pipelines CI/CD, testes automatizados e automação de infraestrutura em produtos reais.  
  • Experiência colaborando com times de ciência de dados para implantação, otimização e monitoramento de modelos de machine learning em produção.  
  • Experiência em design ou operação de sistemas distribuídos de alta performance para workloads de dados ou mídia.  
  • Experiência trabalhando com times de produto, engenharia e analytics para entrega de soluções ponta a ponta.  


Competências Técnicas e Funcionais:  


  • Capacidade de projetar arquiteturas escaláveis, seguras e orientadas a vídeo e IA usando Azure, GCP ou similares.  
  • Conhecimento de frameworks arquiteturais, padrões de documentação e modelos de referência para sistemas em larga escala.  
  • Proficiência em Infrastructure as Code (ex: Terraform ou equivalente) para provisionamento e automação de infraestrutura em nuvem.  
  • Forte capacidade de construir e manter pipelines CI/CD, workloads containerizados e processos automatizados de deploy.  
  • Experiência em operacionalização de modelos de ML, monitoramento de modelos e suporte a fluxos de trabalho de ciência de dados (MLOps).  
  • Expertise em design de sistemas robustos, modulares e escaláveis, incluindo microservices e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.  
  • Forte entendimento de segurança de dados, compliance, GDPR e princípios de IA Responsável.  
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas para conectar times técnicos e de negócio.  
  • Entendimento de requisitos da indústria de mídia (video workflows, metadados de conteúdo e compliance) é um diferencial importante.  


Formação e Certificações:  


  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Cloud Computing ou área relacionada.  
  • Certificações em nuvem como Azure Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect ou similares são altamente valorizadas. 


Idiomas  


  • Inglês fluente, como requisito obrigatório 
  • Espanhol e Francês fluente é desejável

  • Experiência com integração, transformação, armazenamento e análise de dados, incluindo workflows de vídeo (ingestão, processamento, transformação e análise).  
  • Experiência comprovada na implementação de pipelines CI/CD, testes automatizados e automação de infraestrutura em produtos reais.

  • Experiência em design ou operação de sistemas distribuídos de alta performance para workloads de dados ou mídia.

  • Conhecimento de frameworks arquiteturais, padrões de documentação e modelos de referência para sistemas em larga escala.  
  • Proficiência em Infrastructure as Code (ex: Terraform ou equivalente) para provisionamento e automação de infraestrutura em nuvem.  
  • Forte capacidade de construir e manter pipelines CI/CD, workloads containerizados e processos automatizados de deploy.  
  • Experiência em operacionalização de modelos de ML, monitoramento de modelos e suporte a fluxos de trabalho de ciência de dados (MLOps).  
  • Expertise em design de sistemas robustos, modulares e escaláveis, incluindo microservices e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.  
  • Forte entendimento de segurança de dados, compliance, GDPR e princípios de IA Responsável.  
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas para conectar times técnicos e de negócio.  
  • Entendimento de requisitos da indústria de mídia (video workflows, metadados de conteúdo e compliance) é um diferencial importante.  


Formação e Certificações:  


  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Cloud Computing ou área relacionada.  
  • Certificações em nuvem como Azure Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect ou similares são altamente valorizadas.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer (Full-Time, Remote):


We are a modern organic marketing agency looking for a full-time Graphic Designer to join our team.


Our agency helps businesses grow using data-backed social media marketing, and we need someone who can create high-performing graphics and carousels for our clients’ social media pages and advertising campaigns.


This role is perfect for someone who is creative, detail-oriented, and comfortable using AI tools to design quickly and efficiently.


Responsibilities:


Your work will primarily involve designing visuals that help our clients grow their audience and promote their services.


This includes:


• Social media graphics

• Carousel posts for Instagram / LinkedIn

• Promotional graphics (sales, announcements, highlights)

• Ad creatives for marketing campaigns


Most designs will be based on content that is already performing well online, meaning you will often:


• Analyze high-performing posts from competitors

• Take inspiration from those designs

• Recreate and improve them using our branding and messaging


You will be working in a data-backed environment, meaning designs are created strategically based on what works — not randomly.


Important: AI Skills Required


We expect our designers to be modern designers who are comfortable using AI tools.


You will have access to unlimited AI tools, including tools like:


• Google Nano Banana (Pro & 2)

• AI image generation tools

• AI editing tools


In many cases, AI will allow you to create or modify graphics much faster than traditional design methods.


However, you should still be capable of making manual adjustments and edits when needed.


Most of the time you will combine:


• AI-generated visuals

• Inspiration from existing high-performing content

• Custom design adjustments

• Client branding


Requirements:


We are looking for someone who:


• Has strong graphic design skills

• Is comfortable using AI tools in their workflow

• Can follow branding guidelines

• Pays close attention to detail

• Works efficiently and independently

• Is hardworking and takes pride in their work


We value people who take their work seriously and consistently put in effort.


Work Schedule:

•Full-time

•Monday – Friday

•9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (Eastern Standard Timezone)


Compensation:

•$750 per month


Application Requirement (Important)


To apply, you must complete a short design assignment.


Create one data-backed social media graphic or carousel for the brand:


Product Prep


Product Prep teaches automotive finance managers how to sell more cars and warranties.


Your goal is to design a graphic or carousel that would perform well on social media for this audience.


You may:


• Use inspiration from existing posts in the industry

• Use AI tools to help create the design

• Apply your own design skills and creativity


Submit this design along with your application.


We are looking for candidates who clearly take time and effort in their work.


If your submission shows strong effort and skill, there is a very good chance you will be hired.


How to Apply


Please submit:


Your portfolio (if available)


Your completed Product Prep design assignment


A short introduction about yourself


  • We look forward to seeing your work.

title: Consultor SAP FI – Suporte & Sustentação
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que buscamos?

O profissional atuará com foco principal em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade, aderência às regras locais (Brasil e LATAM) e alinhamento com diretrizes globais. Também participará de projetos, melhorias e iniciativas de evolução do sistema, conforme demanda do negócio.


  • Contrato: Vaga temporária - Duração de 1 mês, ideal para profissionais disponíveis imediatamente, atuando com SAP FI!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Atuar prioritariamente na sustentação e suporte do SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade do ambiente e atendimento às demandas do negócio.
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes e requisições relacionadas aos processos financeiros.
  • Apoiar as áreas de Finanças e Controladoria na correta utilização do sistema.
  • Garantir aderência às regras fiscais brasileiras e requisitos LATAM.
  • Realizar análises funcionais detalhadas e propor soluções alinhadas às melhores práticas.
  • Configurar, testar e validar soluções no SAP FI.
  • Apoiar processos como: Fechamento contábil mensal (Month-End Close); Integrações financeiras; Especificidades fiscais brasileiras; Integrações com outros módulos SAP.
  • Identificar melhorias contínuas em processos e parametrizações.
  • Elaborar documentação funcional, especificações e evidências de testes.
  • Participar de projetos de implementação, rollouts, melhorias e upgrades SAP.
  • Conduzir workshops para levantamento de requisitos quando necessário.
  • Validar e testar especificidades Brasil e LATAM durante atualizações do sistema.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de CSV para garantir conformidade regulatória.
  • Assegurar qualidade e integridade dos dados financeiros no SAP.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente profissionais juniores, compartilhando conhecimento e boas práticas.
  • Atuar como interface entre Brasil/LATAM e Headquarter para temas relacionados a SAP FI.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia, Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação ou melhorias SAP.
  • Conhecimento de regras fiscais brasileiras e requisitos LATAM.
  • Certificação SAP FI (desejável).
  • Diferencial: Conhecimento em CO.
  • Diferencial: Inglês ou espanhol


Onde você irá trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido - Curitiba/PR.

  • Experiência com Java 21+, utilizando Spring Boot.
  • Boa compreensão de APIs REST, integração entre sistemas e microsserviços.
  • Vivência com testes unitários (Jest, Jasmine, Karma, JUnit, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações, performance e observabilidade.
  • Experiência com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia no segmento financeiro.
  • Atuação em projetos de larga escala e alto volume de usuários.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência com Git
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma, com visão crítica e foco em qualidade.


Na CWI Software, acreditamos que o sucesso dos nossos projetos está diretamente ligado ao desenvolvimento e bem-estar das pessoas. Oferecemos um ambiente inclusivo, colaborativo e com reais oportunidades de crescimento profissional, valorizando a excelência técnica e a troca de conhecimento.


Vem construir soluções de alto impacto com a gente!

title: Product Designer Senior (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Pega Developer
description:
We are hiring an experienced Pega Developer to drive digital transformation initiatives across public sector programs.


This role sits at the core of mission-critical modernization efforts, combining deep technical expertise in Pega with system integration, workflow design, and scalable architecture. You will design and deliver secure, high-performance case management solutions that improve operational efficiency and service delivery for government agencies.

You will transform complex business requirements into robust Pega applications — integrating enterprise systems, modernizing legacy environments, and ensuring compliance with public sector standards. This person acts as a key technical partner to Architects, Business Analysts, QA, and Delivery teams.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and implement applications using the Pega Platform
  • Configure case types, workflows, user interfaces, data models, and business rules
  • Develop and test integrations using REST and SOAP APIs with enterprise and legacy systems
  • Collaborate with Architects, Business Analysts, and QA teams to ensure successful delivery
  • Execute unit, system, and integration testing, and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
  • Participate in deployment planning, release management, and production support
  • Ensure compliance with public sector security and accessibility standards
  • Document technical specifications, configurations, and testing procedures


Required Experience & Skills:


  • 3+ years of experience in Pega application development
  • Experience working across full SDLC implementations
  • Strong knowledge of system integrations, APIs, and data management
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Advanced English (written and spoken)
  • Pega Certification (CSA, CSSA, or LSA)


Nice to have:


  • Experience with Federal or State/Local government projects
  • Familiarity with security and compliance standards


Why join Genesis Consulting:


  • Work on high-impact digital transformation projects in the public sector
  • Be part of a collaborative, mission-driven team
  • Opportunity for professional growth and development

title: Analista de Governança de TI Sênior
description:
Se você gosta de desafios e quer mostrar todo o seu potencial, queremos te conhecer! A Vericode preza por um time inclusivo e repleto de diversidade, nas suas mais variadas representações. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência!

#VemSerVericoder

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter políticas, normas, processos e procedimentos de Governança de TI e Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios, assegurando sua aderência as melhores práticas do mercado e regulamentações aplicáveis;
  • Atuar como ponto focal para assuntos que envolvam os processos de Gestão de Incidentes, Mudanças,
  • Problemas e Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios, assegurando sua execução eficaz e eficiente;
  • Desenvolver, testar e manter os documentos, diretrizes e procedimentos da Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios;
  • Avaliar e monitorar a eficácia dos controles de TI, identificando gaps e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Elaborar relatórios e indicadores de desempenho relacionados aos processos de Governança de TI mudanças, incidentes, problemas e continuidade de negócios;
  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo informações e implementando as recomendações;
  • Prestar suporte e orientação aos membros da equipe e outras áreas da empresa em relação as práticas da área de Governança de TI.
  • Planejamento e coordenação/análise de testes de recuperação de desastres (infraestrutura cloud e restore backup);
  • Análises de mecanismos de resiliência e continuidade de operações;
  • Criação e revisão/atualização de documentos relativos a GCN (plano de continuidade, planos de recuperação de desastres, contingência, dentre outros).

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa;
  • Sólida experiência em funções de Governança de TI com foco em Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios, Gestão de Incidentes, Mudanças e Gestão de Problemas;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de mercado como ITIL e/ou COBIT;
  • Experiência na elaboração e execução de Planos de Continuidade de Negócios e Planos de Contingência ou Recuperação de Desastres para ambientes de TI.
  • Experiência com BIA - Business Impact Analysis;
  • Certificação na norma ISO 22301 - Sistema de Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios.

Diferenciais:

  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Governança de TI, Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios, Segurança da Informação ou Gestão de Riscos
  • Certificação ISO 22301 – Sistema de Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios;
  • Certificação ISO 27001 – Sistema de Gestão de Segurança da Informação;
  • Certificação ISO 31000 – Gestão de Riscos;
  • Cursos relacionados aos frameworks de Governança de TI;
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação de frameworks de Governança de TI;
  • Experiência com Gestão de Continuidade de Negócios.

Informações adicionais:

Remuneração CLT


Benefícios:

  • Reembolso de Capacitações Técnicas: Cobertura de 100% para certificações profissionais, além de reembolso para cursos de capacitação técnica;
